messages.subject: reneg_in ( ) looping sim.
parts:
reneg_in() is looping a branch after the function.  See example below.  Commenting out reneg_in() allows the simulation to run as expected with the arrival exiting after using trajectory "resource2".

Thanks in advance,

David

library(simmer)                                                                               
testsim <- simmer()                                                                           
test_traj <- trajectory() %>%                                                                 
renege_in(10,                                                                                 
out = trajectory() %>%                                                                        
set_prioritization(c(1,1,F), mod = "+") %>%                                                   
rollback(2)                                                                                   
) %>%                                                                                         
seize("resource",1) %>%                                                                       
timeout(  10 ) %>%                                                                            
release("resource",1 ) %>%                                                                    
branch(option = function()  sample(1:2, prob = c(1,0), size = 1), continue = c(F,F),          
trajectory("resource2") %>%                                                                   
seize("resource2",1) %>%                                                                      
timeout( 200 ) %>%                                                                            
leave(1),                                                                                     
trajectory(name = "none") %>%                                                                 
timeout(0))                                                                                   
                                                                                              
testsim %>%                                                                                   
add_resource("resource", Inf) %>%                                                             
add_resource("resource2", Inf) %>%                                                            
add_generator(trajectory = test_traj, name_prefix = "test", distribution = at(1),priority = 1)
#> simmer environment: anonymous | now: 0 | next: 0
#> { Monitor: in memory }
#> { Resource: resource | monitored: TRUE | server status: 0(Inf) | queue status: 0(Inf) }
#> { Resource: resource2 | monitored: TRUE | server status: 0(Inf) | queue status: 0(Inf) }
#> { Source: test | monitored: 1 | n_generated: 0 }
                                                                                              
                                                                                              
testsim  %>% run(40)                                                                          
#> simmer environment: anonymous | now: 40 | next: 41
#> { Monitor: in memory }
#> { Resource: resource | monitored: TRUE | server status: 1(Inf) | queue status: 0(Inf) }
#> { Resource: resource2 | monitored: TRUE | server status: 0(Inf) | queue status: 0(Inf) }
#> { Source: test | monitored: 1 | n_generated: 1 }
                                                                                              
testsim %>%                                                                                   
get_mon_resources()                                                                           
#>     resource time server queue capacity queue_size system limit
#> 1   resource    1      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 2   resource   11      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 3  resource2   11      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 4  resource2   11      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 5   resource   11      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 6   resource   21      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 7  resource2   21      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 8  resource2   21      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 9   resource   21      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 10  resource   31      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 11 resource2   31      1     0      Inf        Inf      1   Inf
#> 12 resource2   31      0     0      Inf        Inf      0   Inf
#> 13  resource   31      1     0      Inf        Inf      1

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] reneg_in ( ) looping sim.
parts:
It's looping because there is a loop. Each time resource2 is reached,
the reneging timer expires, the out trajectory is called, and the
arrival rolls back to renege_in, which starts the sequence again.

Iñaki
